description: This file defines the SystemInfo class and related functions for retrieving system information such as memory, CPU load, and environment variables within the WPEFramework project. It also declares external functions and metadata related to the module.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Provides system information such as memory, CPU load, environment variables, and time settings. Implements singleton pattern and includes nested MemorySnapshot class for capturing memory state.

classes.name: SystemInfo::MemorySnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of system memory statistics, with methods to output data as JSON and access individual metrics.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Generates a device ID based on raw device data and a key length.

methods.name: GetEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable.

methods.name: SetEnvironment
methods.description: Sets the value of an environment variable, with an option to force the change.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SystemInfo.

methods.name: ~SystemInfo
methods.description: Destructor for SystemInfo.

methods.name: SetTime
methods.description: Sets the system time.

methods.name: SetTimeZone
methods.description: Sets the system time zone.

methods.name: AsJSON
methods.description: Outputs the memory snapshot as a JSON string.

methods.name: Total
methods.description: Returns total memory in bytes.

methods.name: Free
methods.description: Returns free memory in bytes.

methods.name: Available
methods.description: Returns available memory in bytes.

methods.name: Cached
methods.description: Returns cached memory in bytes.

methods.name: SwapTotal
methods.description: Returns total swap space in bytes.

methods.name: SwapFree
methods.description: Returns free swap space in bytes.

methods.name: SwapCached
methods.description: Returns cached swap space in bytes.

methods.name: TakeMemorySnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of current memory statistics.

methods.name: Ticks
methods.description: Returns the current system tick count in microseconds.

methods.name: Architecture
methods.description: Returns the system architecture string.

methods.name: Chipset
methods.description: Returns the chipset information string.

methods.name: FirmwareVersion
methods.description: Returns the firmware version string.
